chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Moroccan woman about 22, long wavy dark brown hair, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 24, short black fade haircut, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a dark green bomber jacket over a plain white t-shirt
chars.HOST: HOST: a young Moroccan man about 24 with curly black hair, wearing a maroon tracksuit with white stripes
chars.NEWGUYS: NEWGUYS: two young Moroccan men, one in a black leather jacket with a thin gold chain, the other in a white tracksuit and a black cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen as on a phone video call screen held by the viewer: GIRL in her bedroom in Casablanca leans close to the camera, smiling a little too sweetly, eyebrows raised, asking for permission, a stack of textbooks behind her. Head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible, centered.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sitting on a university campus bench in Casablanca with a small group of four students (two girls, two boys) holding notebooks, she points at them excitedly. Subjects in the center, calm background.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Evening, the doorway of a modern Moroccan apartment: HOST opens the door with a friendly grin while GIRL stands at the threshold holding textbooks, looking back over her shoulder a bit nervously. Head-to-waist, faces visible, centered.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan apartment living room with a low table covered in books: HOST introduces NEWGUYS who just walked in, smirking and confident. Subjects centered, warm lamp light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Seen as on a phone video call screen: GIRL lying on her bed, laughing and waving her hand dismissively, saying it's nothing, an open notebook beside her. Face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, a plain bedroom: NARRATOR sitting on the edge of his bed holding his phone, sighing with a reluctant half-smile, nodding as if giving in. Head-to-waist, face visible, centered.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Night, NARRATOR standing at a window with arms crossed, phone in one hand, staring into the distance thoughtfully, trusting but uneasy. Face visible, centered, calm dark background.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Late night in a Moroccan apartment living room: the textbooks lie closed and pushed aside on the low table; GIRL laughs loudly on the sofa between NEWGUYS, one of them leaning close to her. Seen from the doorway, faces visible, centered, dim warm light.
